marketing_description: The DeWALT DCF961B Cordless High Torque Impact Wrench features a 1/2 in square drive, 1200 ft-lb fastening torque and 1750 ft-lb breakaway torque, powered by a 20 V lithium-ion battery. It includes a 4-mode push button switch and a hog ring anvil for quick socket changes. The tool is built with a glass-filled nylon housing and a brushless motor.
